spans.s: Basilěos Basilěon Měgalŏu (IE 8-2), Greek; ‘of the great king of kings;’ used in the legend on the coins of the Scytho-Parthian kings; adapted from old Persian Khshyāthiya Khshāya-thiyānām, ‘the king of kings’; translated into Prakrit as Maha-rajasa Rajarajasa (or Rajadirajasa) mahalasa (Sanskrit Mahā-rājasya Rājarājasya mahataḥ or Rājātirājasya mahataḥ).

Basilěos Měgalŏu (IE 8-2), Greek; ‘of the great king’, found in the legend on the coins of Indo-Greek kings at first translated in Prakrit as Rajasa mahatakasa (Sanskrit Rājñaḥ mahataḥ) and later as Maharajasa (Sanskrit Mahārājasya); adapted from old Persian Kshāyathiya vazrka.
